shortDescription: Beautifully designed, inside and out. Find inspiration in a dishwasher that looks as good as it performs. The FlushFit design blends seamlessly with your cabinets to bring out the best in your space, while the large LED back panel lighting provides added interior brightness and easy visibility of your dishes. Timesavers like our leading 1-Hour Wash & Dry cycle that brings out the best in your dishes paired with elevated cleaning and drying technologies that make your dishware and glass stemware shine. There’s even a BlastZone Bottle Wash designed to clean your favorite beverage tumblers and more.

images.label: Top Control Panels with a Hand

features.text: Your kitchen deserves a look that is flawlessly designed. That’s why LG SIGNATURE created our FlushFit™ dishwasher. The finished aesthetic is sleek and seamless yet still fits an impressive 16 place settings inside. It's an instant kitchen upgrade.
Stand Out Design. Ready in an Hour.

LG SIGNATURE QuadWash® Pro and Dynamic Heat Dry™ technologies combine to deliver LG SIGNATURE's leading 1-hour wash and dry cycle for sparkling, table-ready dishes in less time. So you can spend more time doing what you love.

The large LED back panel lighting provides added interior lighting and brightness, allowing you to check on dishes in an instant. This elegant, lit interior ensures easy visibility of your dishware and stemware, illuminating the entire tub so you can always see the beautiful results of every cycle.
Make everyday at home a little easier with the enhanced cleaning power of QuadWash® Pro. High-pressure jets with 38% more cleaning power, spray dishes from multiple angles.

With TrueSteam®, you can skip the hassle of prewashing. A powerful initial steam blast penetrates and loosens stubborn, baked‑on residue while staying gentle on delicate stemware. A final burst of steam helps reduce water spots, leaving glasses clear and ready for the table.
Effortless Cleaning for Tumblers, Pans and More!

The LG SIGNATURE BlastZone™ Bottle Wash uses dedicated jets to deliver a complete wash and dry in 1 hour. More than just tumblers, it’s perfect for scrubbing caked-on casserole dishes or pots and pans, effortlessly.
